info.name: School API — Campus Session
info.description:
Campus director session on `{slug}.{{rootHost}}`. **Documented:** `GET|POST|DELETE /school-accounts/campus-session`.

- Host: `{{schoolHost}}`. App / admin / apex → 403 `Campus login is only allowed on that school's host` (not the app-host 403 text).
- Sign-in writes `{{campusAccessToken}}`. Same HMAC family as school first-login (`:school-account-session`). Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify.
- **DELETE is not school DELETE.** Campus read treats suspended / slug-mismatch as **401**, and DELETE only forwards **403** (non-campus host). Missing token, invalid token, admin token, and suspended all return `200 { "ok": true }`.

Shared environment: `environments/School-API.local.postman_environment.json`.

- `{{baseUrl}}` is the **backend** (`http://127.0.0.1:5000`), not Next on `3000`.
- Prefer `x-school-host` over `Host`. Matching lowercases and strips `:{port}`.
- Tokens are HMAC (`payload.signature`), not JWT. Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify on school/campus routes (different HMAC material). School and campus share `:school-account-session`.
- Error JSON (except health): `{ "error": "<string>" }`. No 422. Wrapper-only 500 is `{ "error": "Internal server error" }`.
- Do not invent routes or status codes. Later batches land in the matching collection file — do not grow a monolith.

item.name: Campus Session
item.description: Campus host only (`{{schoolHost}}` = `{slug}.e-school.et:3000`). Error for app/admin/apex: `Campus login is only allowed on that school's host`. Reuse `{{schoolEmail}}` / `{{schoolPassword}}` after first-login. POST writes `{{campusAccessToken}}`. DELETE acknowledges sign-out: 403 only when the host is not a campus host; 401s (including suspended) still return 200.

header.description: HMAC campus/school-family token (`:school-account-session`). Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify. Missing, empty, invalid, expired, unknown account, inactive/suspended, missing slug, or host-slug mismatch → 401.

**Required campus host.** `{slug}.{{rootHost}}` (e.g. `north-ridge.e-school.et:3000`). App / admin / apex / reserved labels (`www` `api` `app` `admin` `mail` `ftp`) → 403 `Campus login is only allowed on that school's host`. **Not** the app-host 403 text.

request.description:
Returns the current campus director session when the Bearer token is a valid school HMAC **and** `x-school-host` is **that school's campus host**.

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{campusAccessToken}}` from `POST /school-accounts/campus-session`. Same HMAC family as `{{schoolAccessToken}}` (`:school-account-session`). Platform admin tokens → 401.

**Who:** a director whose tenant is `active` **and** whose `slug` equals the host label. First-login (no slug) and suspended/pending accounts fail as **401** `{ "error": "Unauthorized" }` — campus GET does **not** return `This school account is suspended`.

**Host (required):** `rejectIfNotCampusHost`. Must be `{slug}.{{rootHost}}` after port strip, not reserved, not `app.` / `admin.`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`. A **valid** other-school campus host with this token is **401** (slug mismatch), not 403.

**Side effects:** none. Does not rotate or extend the token.

**Success `200`:** `{ accountId, email, expiresAt, slug, host }` — **no `token`**, no `mustChangePassword`, no `nextStep`. `host` has no port.

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized (token / account / slug / not-active); 403 campus-host error only; 405 for methods other than GET/POST/DELETE. `DELETE` exists (Batch 4) — do not treat it as 405.

**Not used:** 400, 404, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

header.description: JSON body. Invalid JSON → 400. Empty body parses as `{}` and empty credentials → 401 (not 400).
**Required campus host** matching that account's slug. App / admin / apex → 403 `Campus login is only allowed on that school's host`. A different school's campus host → 403 `Use your campus host`.

request.description:
Issues an HMAC campus session when credentials match an **active** tenant whose **claimed slug** equals the campus host label.

**Auth:** none on the request. Email is trimmed and lowercased (`normalizeTenantEmail`). Non-string or missing `email` / `password` become `""` — there is **no field-level 400**. Bad, empty, or unknown credentials → `401 { "error": "Invalid email, school ID, or password" }`.

**Who:** a director who finished first-login (password changed **and** username claimed). App-host sign-in of a claimed account is 403 `Use your campus host` — this is the replacement route.

**Host (required):** `rejectIfNotCampusHost` on `{slug}.{{rootHost}}`. App / admin / apex / reserved / empty → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }` — **not** `School accounts are only allowed on the app host`.

**Side effects:** issues a new HMAC token (same family `:school-account-session`, `SESSION_TTL_SECONDS`). Does not set cookies. The test script writes `{{campusAccessToken}}`.

**Success `200`:** `{ accountId, email, expiresAt, slug, host, token }`. No `mustChangePassword` / `nextStep`.

**Errors that exist:** 400 invalid JSON; 401 bad/empty/unknown credentials; 403 campus-host error, `This school account is not active` (`pending_setup` / `suspended` — different text from app-host `This school account is suspended`), `Change your password first`, or `Use your campus host` (slug null or host label ≠ account slug); 405 other methods (DELETE is Batch 4, not 405).

**Not used:** 404, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

header.description: Optional for a 200. The handler calls `readCampusAccountSession` but **only forwards 403**. Missing, empty, invalid, expired, admin, unknown-account, inactive, suspended, missing-slug, and host-slug mismatch are all **401 from the reader** and become `200 { "ok": true }`.

**Required campus host** (`{slug}.{{rootHost}}`, e.g. `north-ridge.e-school.et:3000`). App / admin / apex / reserved / empty → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`. A **valid other-school campus host** is not 403 (reader 401 → DELETE 200).

request.description:
Client-side sign-out acknowledgement for the campus director session.

**Auth:** the handler **does** call `readCampusAccountSession`, but only **403** results are forwarded. Every **401** from that reader is treated as success.

**Who:** the campus Next app calls this to drop its stored token. Anyone who can reach the backend on a **campus host** can get 200; it is a no-op on the server when not 403.

**Host (required):** `rejectIfNotCampusHost`. Must be `{slug}.{{rootHost}}` after port strip, not reserved, not `app.` / `admin.` / apex. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`. **Not** the app-host 403 text.

**Do not copy school DELETE.** School `readSchoolAccountSession` returns **403** `{ "error": "This school account is suspended" }` for a suspended tenant, so school DELETE forwards that 403. Campus read maps `status !== "active"`, null slug, and host-slug mismatch to **401** `{ "error": "Unauthorized" }`, so campus DELETE returns **200** for suspended and for a token used on a different school's campus host.

**Do not copy admin DELETE.** Admin DELETE never checks host or token.

**Side effects:** **none on the server.** HMAC tokens stay valid until `expiresAt`. The client must discard `{{campusAccessToken}}`. There is no deny-list.

**Success:** `200 { "ok": true }` when the read is ok **or** the error is 401 (missing / invalid / expired / admin token / unknown account / not active / suspended / slug mismatch).

**Errors that exist:** `403` campus-host error only; `405` for methods other than GET/POST/DELETE.

**Not used:** 400, 401 (swallowed), 404, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.
